description: Allowed import directions between the folders of src/ (stories #42, #55). A folder is the first directory under src/, or the first two under the areas in `twoLevelAreas`. Checked by test/tooling/dependencyDirection.test.cjs; `node test/tooling/folderDependencies.cjs` prints the measured matrix. When files move, rewrite this file, not the test.
layersNote: Top to bottom: a folder may import its own layer or a lower one, never a higher one, and a feature never imports another feature. Folders outside these areas (the pre-#55 tree, `(root)`) are not ranked. Each exception needs a reason.

layerExceptions.features/active-servers->features/collab: The COLLABORATION tree group is nested inside ACTIVE SERVERS by design (ARCHITECTURE "Activation flow"): ActiveServersSectionProvider builds it with CollaborationSectionProvider and activeServerItems uses collaborationItems. The alternative, moving the two collaboration view files under features/active-servers/views/, was left to the maintainer (src-layout.md §3.5).

twoWayPairs.core/analysis<->core/history: Was inside code_analysis before #55. The Git history services compose the analysis session, the session registry, ExecutePython, the configuration storage and the analysis file policy (core/history -> core/analysis), while the re-analysis watchers publish on analysisUpdateEvents (core/analysis/watchers -> core/history/analysisUpdateEvents.ts). Moving that event bus next to the watchers would remove the pair.
twoWayPairs.core/analysis<->core/server: The analysis<->server pair of docs/cleanup/src-layout.md §3.5. The analysis bridges are hosted by the HTTP server (core/server/analysis/* -> core/analysis refresh, watchers and the session registry) and stopping a server closes its analysis session (core/server/serverControl.ts -> core/analysis/session); the analysis engine launches and notifies servers (core/analysis/session-servers -> multiServerLauncher, SSEManager, fileToServerMap, ServerSettingsManager). Inverting it means registering the bridges from the analysis side and an event or callback seam for the session (#13).
twoWayPairs.core/remote-access<->core/server: The servers authorize remote requests with RemoteSessionAuthority and the remote-access model (core/server -> core/remote-access), and RemoteAccessManager watches the running-server registry to stop a tunnel when its server goes and reads and turns off the cross-network setting through ServerSettingsManager (core/remote-access -> core/server). Breaking it needs that setting and the registry events behind an injected accessor (#13).

vscodeFreeNote: src files from which no import path reaches `vscode` (type imports included). 97 when #42 started; may only go up. Raise the floor when it does. #55 batch 0 lowered it 109 -> 106 only because three vscode-free re-export barrels were deleted (configuration/models, customComponents, refresh index.ts); no surviving file lost the property. #13 step 1 raised it 106 -> 116: 114 measured on v1.2.1 at 6f827a19 (docs/ide/vscode-api-inventory.md), plus the two vscode-free files of the new core/host seam. #13 step 2 raised it 116 -> 118 (core/host/hostPaths.ts and core/analysis/python/backendScriptPath.ts). #13 step 2b raised it 118 -> 122 (settingsFile, generatedHttpsCertificateManager, pythonEnvStorage, themeUtils take structural FileLocation/GlobalStorageContext). #173/#178 raised it by 3: core/metrics/functionMetrics.ts, core/metrics/functionMetricsTracker.ts and core/analysis/analysisEvents.ts, shared with the Code-XR IDE.
